body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q1FY25 call (2024-08-09), prompted: "for the full year, like I said, it could be flat to maybe minus 2%, 3% or something like that" Metric: Consolidated revenue from operations FY25 YoY. Target: 0% to -3% YoY (~INR 1,106-1,140 cr on FY24 INR 1,140 cr). Deadline: 2025-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: MISSED. Evidence: FY25 revenue INR 964 cr = -15.4% YoY (screener; Q4FY25 call). Guidance cut to 'flattish H2' in Nov-2024 and missed by ~12 pts. Management explanation: Back-to-back downturns in large ag (US/EU) and construction, plus customer destocking; 'I wish I had a crystal ball'.
